title: SiMa Neat Model Registry licenses
description: artifact-browser/licenses.json: every license a model.yaml may declare in license.spdx, by SPDX ID. A license without an SPDX ID uses LicenseRef-<Name>.

name.description: The license's name, shown beside its ID on the model page.

summary.description: What the license asks of someone who redistributes the model, in one or two sentences shown on the model page.

downloadable.description: false when the license does not permit redistributing the model. The model page then offers no download.
